_comment: Retailer overlay card: Albertsons supplier requirements. ASN with KDEs for all foods; GTIN, lot/batch, voice-pick code, and pack/sell-by date on every case. Data, not code.

citation.section_ref: Albertsons: ASN + GTIN/lot/voice-pick/date on every case
citation.support_text: Albertsons requires ASNs with KDEs for all foods and case labels carrying GTIN, lot/batch, voice-pick code, and pack or sell-by date.

rules.note: Case labels must carry GTIN + (10) lot + a (13)/(15) date (see gs1.validate_gs1_label_fields).
